items.stem: What is posterior collapse in a VAE?

options.text: The latent code is ignored and the decoder relies on little or no latent information
options.rationale: Correct: the KL term can drive the posterior toward the prior, ignoring z.

options.text: The decoder outputs only noise forever
The learning rate collapses to zero
